scope: Explicitly derived real-valued total-fderiv interfaces; not literal whole-carrier Definition6.4 or full Algorithm15.8/Theorem15.30

classification_rules.SOURCE: Explicit condition in sealed derived-interface scope with raw-source relation recorded for each; not automatic literal-source equivalence.
classification_rules.STANDING: Only separately audited source-wide assumptions; none silently added.
classification_rules.TYPING: Carrier/structure and quantified data with source carrier delta recorded.
classification_rules.RULED: Requires human-approved source correction; no such correction used.
classification_rules.EXCESS: Proof result or convenience premise unsupported even in bounded derived scope; none found.

definition_audit.fallback: No candidate-created default branch, but the referenced Mathlib fderiv returns zero at nondifferentiable points. D then equals psi(x)-psi(y).
definition_audit.source_domain: X x int X, psi strictly convex and differentiable on nonempty int X, finite-dimensional Euclidean gradient pairing.
definition_audit.actual_domain: Every pair of points in every real normed space, arbitrary ambient real function.
definition_audit.acceptance_boundary: Accept this as an explicitly named derived total algebraic interface with source agreement only on admissible differentiable data and inner-product adapter; reject any claim of literal Def6.4 equality across its widened carrier.

project_owned_assumption_bundles: Only D is project-owned in these interfaces and is fully expanded; no opaque project Prop/typeclass assumption bundles.
